correctness.rationale: Reconstructed finite modal equivalence on named two-element equivalence blocks: if x and y agree on every modal formula, their matching neighbor-class unordered pairs force agreement of the unique opposite endpoints, and iteration forces equality of all left-multiplied rooted color functions. The converse relation is a bisimulation; finite partition refinement defines each class. Singleton atoms therefore require free, pairwise disjoint right-color orbits. Subgroup-lattice Mobius inversion of q^[G:H] then counts free colors and falling factorial gives ordered tuple count; dihedral rotation-reflection disjointness proves P_{q²}(m)-mP_q(m). Independently counted 8 free binary colorings of the Klein four group, and verified that two component representatives give 8*(8-4)=32. The attached script source was inspected but not used as authority for the universal proof.
residual_risks: Computer enumeration corroborates but cannot replace the stated arbitrary-parameter proof.
